datalist.name: La Jouissance phallique
datalist.desc:
Peroleh 1 [ChargeRougeAlly] Count every time [Laceration] is activated in this Encounter (10 times per turn)

Combat End: At 15+ [ChargeRougeAlly] Count, if this unit is not in [BuffetSinclair] state, consume all [ChargeRougeAlly] Count to gain 3 [BuffetSinclair] next turn
- Heal SP equal to (3 x [ChargeRougeAlly] Count consumed beyond 15) (max 15)

When [BuffetSinclair] expires, consume all [ChargeRougeAlly] Count on self to heal HP equal to ([ChargeRougeAlly] Count consumed x 2)

Gain 1 [ChargeRougeAlly] Potency for every 10 cumulative [ChargeRougeAlly] Count this unit consumes in this Encounter

This unit's Base Attack Skills and Clashable Counter Skills are considered as Skills that gain [Charge] Count
datalist.summary: Peroleh [ChargeRougeAlly] Count every time [Laceration] is activated

datalist.name: La Fin de l'Enfance
datalist.desc:
Peroleh [HungrySinclair] based on the following conditions (50 per turn):
- When this unit consumes [ChargeRougeAlly] Count, gain Stack equal to [ChargeRougeAlly] Count consumed
- When this unit's Base Skills heal other allies' HP, gain Stack equal to actual amount healed
- Peroleh 1 Stack for every 10 cumulative HP allies lost
- On Base Attack Hit by another "Le Rouge" allied Identity, gain 2 Stacks
- Akhir Giliran: Peroleh 5 Stacks for every other "Le Rouge" allied Identity on the field

Turn End: At 100+ [HungrySinclair], and if this unit does not have [TransformSinclair], replace the Skill on the leftmost Skill Slot's bottom row with "La Voracité" at the next Turn Start

Combat Start: If this unit equipped "La Voracité" or "La Castration" for the first time in this Encounter, gain [BuffetThirst] and [TransformSinclair]; then, remove this unit's Stagger Threshold
- Replace equipped Base Skills with [TransformSinclair] exclusive Skills
- Base Skills that targeted allies activate Unopposed Attack against random enemies
- At Attack End of the Skill activated by the said effect, consume all [HungrySinclair]

Turn End: At 150 [HungrySinclair], if this unit has [TransformSinclair], and if this unit does not have "La Voracité" on its Dashboard at the next Turn Start, replace a Base Skill with "La Voracité" (prioritizes the Skill on the leftmost Slot's bottom row)
datalist.flavor:
Who decides where childhood ends?

The crimson child set out on an adventure all on his lonesome.
Tracing memories, longing for what was lost, the child walked on with friendless steps... and in loneliness, bade farewell to childhood.

datalist.name: La Moisson
datalist.desc:
When this unit's Base Skill effects consume an ally's HP, the ally cannot become Staggered by the said effects, and its HP does not drop below 1.

Combat End: At 3+ Lust Reson., apply [BuffetThirst] next turn on (Lust Reson. / 3) other allies (rounded up)
- Prioritizes "Le Rouge" allies, in Deployment order

When using a [SupportAlly] Skill on an ally, apply 1 [BuffetFriendShield] to the non-immobilized "Le Rouge" ally with the highest current HP (once per turn)
At Base Attack End by another allied [PersonalityCharge], if the said Skill did not defeat its main target, use "Je vous aide" against that enemy (once per turn)
datalist.summary:
When using a [SupportAlly] Skill on an ally, apply [BuffetFriendShield]
Apply [BuffetThirst] on ally next turn based on Lust Reson.

datalist.name: Les Pouvoirs de la vie
datalist.desc:
When a "Le Rouge" ally becomes Staggered due to damage, use "Le Manque-à-être" on the said ally (once per turn, excluding forced Stagger)

If this unit does not have [TransformSinclair],
- When a non-"Le Rouge" ally becomes Staggered due to damage, use "Le Manque-à-être" on the said ally (once per Encounter, excluding forced Stagger)

If this unit has [TransformSinclair],
- When another "Le Rouge" ally takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, HP does not drop below 1, and the said ally heals 50% HP (rounded up, once per Encounter per Identity)

datalist.name: Voracious Overindulgence
datalist.desc:
Combat Start: Apply 2 [AttackUp] to the ally with the lowest HP
The said ally heals 5% HP at Attack Skill End (min 1, once per turn)
